name: HD 275354B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-6038 A and HD 275354B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 237640407346340736 and 237640407346341376), 3,183 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 5.2e-5: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to TOI-6038 A, 3,183 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 194736419 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 194736419 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: HD 275354B is a star of 5,110 K, bound to TOI-6038 A 3,183 AU away.
text.introduction: HD 275354B shares its motion through space with TOI-6038 A, 3,183 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: HD 275354B's orbit around TOI-6038 A is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
